Answer: E
Reason: The PA view (Figure 1a) clearly demonstrates tracheomegaly (indicated by arrowheads) and ill-defined opacities in the right lower lobe, while increased linear opacities are visible in the left pulmonary base (indicated by the single arrow), which is consistent with cylindrical bronchiectasis associated with Mounier-Kuhn syndrome. Although the report generator hallucinated metastatic disease, visual verification confirms the specific anatomical findings described in option E.
